issue.title: [Enhancement][Snappi]: Remove info level log from is_ecn_marked function checking for ECN marking.

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

PR #18705

There is an INFO level log in the following function: tests/common/snappi_tests/read_pcap.py

```
def is_ecn_marked(ip_pkt):
    """
    Determine if an IP packet is ECN congestion marked

    Args:
        ip_pkt (obj): IP packet

    Returns:
        Return if the packet is ECN congestion marked (bool)
    """
    logger.info("Checking if the packet is ECN congestion marked")
    return (ip_pkt.tos & 3) == 3
```

This function is called for each packet to determine if the packet is ECN marked or NOT.

@sdszhang , @auspham , @kamalsahu0001 , @selldinesh

### Current Behavior

Since the log is set to INFO level, an INFO level log is generated for each packet which is checked ECN-marked or not.

If there are 1000 packets in the PCAPs, then 1000 such lines of logs are generated at INFO level.

### Proposed Behavior

Two alternatives:
(1) The test-case calling this function should print a generic log saying that X packets are checked for ECN-marking, and remove the log completely from this function.

(2) Change the severity of this log to 'DEBUG' to ensure that it does not flood during the test.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
The read_pcap.py file has function "is_ecn_marked" which is checking if the packet is ECN marked or not.

However the logging is set to INFO level, which means that every packet in the PCAP when checked for ECN marking, will generate an INFO level log. For check of 1000 packets, it will generate 1000 such INFO level logs.

#### How did you do it?
Reduced the severity of the log from INFO->DEBUG.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Ran ECN marking testcase. In 'Before' output, since 9k packets are being checked for ECN marked, it will generate 9k INFO level logs. In 'After' logs, the test-case itself is printing if the packet is detected as ECN marked or not.
